paragraphs: Colaj sells a classroom tool it describes as collaborative AI to bring active learning to every classroom. It is aimed at instructors and their students, with a one-time classroom setup that works every session.

During a lecture it produces live captions and key topics, surfaced by AI as the instructor teaches. It listens to the lecture and drafts poll questions from what the instructor just said. Students answer in their own words, and those answers are clustered into comprehension bands that surface the misconception hiding inside them. After class the tool automatically generates a study guide from each session. The instructor dashboard turns each class into a trend line.

The company grounds the design in education research, citing a review of 225 studies that compared traditional lectures with active-learning sections. Colaj says it is piloting now with instructors and universities. It was launched by an MIT-founded design studio with 20 years of experience.

quote.text: Collaborative AI to Bring Active Learning to Every Classroom
